claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean core q and every c>=0, eta>0, the fair activation satisfies L_{c,eta}(A(q))=(1/2)L_{c,eta}(q)+D_R(q)+(2+eta)R(m)-B_z(m)-sum_i C_i(m,p_i)-c(1-m)/2, with all terms defined in PROOF.md.
The universal inequality M+(5/4)U<=2I is false. The fair activation of four-bit mask 56242 has exact positive residual, numerically 0.092343554500715 bits.
At c=2 and eta=1/4, the complete fair-activation node charge need not be nonpositive, even when the child residual is exactly zero.

Find some absolute finite c and eta>0 for which the aggregate signed refund L_{c,eta}<=0 holds universally, or prove GU by another signed aggregate payment. The sharp c=2, eta=1/4 candidate is retired.
